story_zh: 最近，一场现代美术展引发了激烈争论。有人称赞其创造性的抽象作品，认为它彻底打破了传统观念，展现了艺术的进步。然而，另一些人批评作品内容粗糙、主题消极，甚至形容某些形象“丑”得令人反感。媒体评价也呈现矛盾：一方面承认艺术家的成就，另一方面指出作品缺乏深刻的思想，只是刺激观众的感官。这场争议反映了当代文化中不同观点的碰撞。
story_pinyin: Zuìjìn, yī chǎng xiàndài měishù zhǎn yǐnfāle jīliè zhēnglùn. Yǒurén chēngzàn qí chuàngzàoxìng de chōuxiàng zuòpǐn, rènwéi tā chèdǐ dǎpòle chuántǒng guānniàn, zhǎnxiànle yìshù de jìnbù. Rán'ér, lìng yīxiē rén pīpíng zuòpǐn nèiróng cūcāo, zhǔtí xiāojí, shènzhì xíngróng mǒuxiē xíngxiàng “chǒu” dé lìng rén fǎngǎn. Méitǐ píngjià yě chéngxiàn máodùn: yī fāngmiàn chéngrèn yìshùjiā de chéngjiù, lìng yī fāngmiàn zhǐchū zuòpǐn quēfá shēnkè de sīxiǎng, zhǐshì cìjī guānzhòng de gǎnguān. Zhè chǎng zhēngyì fǎnyìngle dāngdài wénhuà zhōng bùtóng guāndiǎn de pèngzhuàng.
story_en: Recently, a modern art exhibition sparked intense debate. Some praised its creative abstract works, believing it completely broke with traditional concepts and showed artistic progress. However, others criticized the works as having rough content and negative themes, even describing some images as so "ugly" they were offensive. Media evaluations also showed contradictions: on one hand acknowledging the artist's achievements, on the other pointing out the works lacked profound thought and merely stimulated viewers' senses. This controversy reflects the collision of different viewpoints in contemporary culture.
